interpretation.supportText: A successful quarantine and national survey program have confined Karnal bunt to portions of one State: Arizona.
interpretation.geographicMeaning: Current NPPO national confinement statement corroborates the separately explicit state negative; no survey completeness claim.

interpretation.finding: EPPO Reporting Service 2000/010 expressly concludes T. indica is not present in Alabama and Tennessee and identifies old reports as T. walkeri misidentifications. Retain this correction history; do not automatically delete unrelated occurrence evidence.

proposedDateMethod.effectiveDateMeaning: Eligibility begins at the separate corroboration authority date, not an invented declaration or eradication day.
proposedDateMethod.conflictBoundaryMeaning: Conservative start of the source information year; not a claimed event or publication date.
proposedDateMethod.expiryMeaning: Project review expiry at authority date plus 365 days, not biological guarantee.

caveats: The EPPO global distribution-table modification date and retrieval timestamps cannot supply a missing state publication day.
An explicit absent classification supports a proposed official status; missing county rows and failed searches supply no negative evidence.
Historical records remain visible. Later or undated credible presence must block current negatives until adjudication.
No assertion, outcome or determination is created by this interpretation.
